narrative.text:
In the last 7 days, 39 transitions occurred, all timestamped on 2026-09-21, reflecting a concentrated burst of activity driven by the pipeline’s seed phase. Of these, 32 were labeled as hubspot_history — meaning they originated from earlier pipeline steps in the demo portal, not organic buyer behavior — while 7 were explicitly seeded movements. The movement concentrated in the subscriber and lead stages, with 17 subscribers and 14 leads created or updated, alongside 2 evangelists, 5 marketingqualifiedleads, and 1 opportunity. This contrasts with the 14- and 30-day windows, which each show 40 transitions: the additional transition in those longer windows occurred on 2026-09-13, when kai8karma+speaker-qhamirani@gmail.com moved from no stage to lead at HighLevel, indicating a slight early engagement that did not repeat or accelerate in the final week.

The accounts driving the 7-day movement include HighLevel (lead), Maybank (lead), Sea Limited Ltd (lead), Majid Al Futtaim (lead), Almarai (subscriber), Axis Bank (lead), Asian Paints (two leads), Qatar Airways (subscriber), HDFC Bank Ltd (subscriber), Chewy (lead and opportunity), Havells (lead), Persistent Systems (subscriber), OCBC (subscriber and lead), Sun Pharma (lead and subscriber), Godrej Consumer Products (lead), Talabat (lead), Emirates Group (subscriber), Apollo Hospitals (marketingqualifiedlead), and Darwinbox (evangelist, subscriber, lead). The seeded transitions on 2026-09-21 at 15:11:42 moved siriporn@ninjavan.co, yalsayed@qatarairways.com, sanjay.rao@hdfcbank.com, dsmith@chewy.com, neha.rao@havells.com, siti@ocbc.com, and vikramn@darwinbox.com to marketingqualifiedlead or opportunity stages — these are the only moves explicitly tagged as seeded and should not be mistaken for organic progression.

Contacts with engagement but no stage change include divya@gmail.com (Self-employed), rjohnson@wayfair.com (Wayfair), jwilson@planetfitness.com (PF), ahmad.hassan98@gmail.com (Self-employed), maryam.alzaabi@almarai.com (Almarai), nisha@yahoo.com (Self-employed Ltd), siriporn@ninjavan.co (NV), pkulkarni@asianpaints.com (asian paints), sanjay.reddy@asianpaints.com (asian paints), yalsayed@qatarairways.com (Qatar Airways), sanjay.rao@hdfcbank.com (HDFC Bank Ltd), dsmith@chewy.com (Chewy), siripornw@ocbc.com (OCBC Ltd), dgupta@persistent.com (Persistent Systems), siti@ocbc.com (OCBC), rverma82@rediffmail.com (Unknown), nehai@sunpharma.com (Sun Pharma), karan.sharma@godrejcp.com (Godrej Consumer Products), muhammad.abdullah@axiata.com (Axiata Ltd), rohann@sunpharma.com (Sun Pharma Ltd), nalfarsi@talabat.com (talabat), djohnson@chewy.com (Chewy Ltd), vikramn@darwinbox.com (Darwinbox), ahmeda@emirates.com (Emirates Group), amit@apollohospitals.com (Apollo Hospitals), and kai8karma+speaker-sudikorba@gmail.com (Darwinbox) — all of whom engaged but remained in their prior stage, indicating no progression despite interaction.
